items.desc_now: 让 AI 在手机内部拿到真 adb shell（uid 2000，无 root、不踢掉你的 Shizuku）

items.desc_now: Free speech-to-text for DeepSeek Harness. Hold the composer microphone and the text is typed into the input box as you speak; on release the whole take is recognized once more and replaces the preview. Also wb_transcribe for long audio and video (WorkBuddy does not bill speech input).
